answer: Each new identity must lock a bond that grows quadratically per operator cluster: the k-th identity costs 5*k POA, so 10 fakes lock 275 POA for 45 epochs. A willow-thin clone farm cannot afford that curve. Auditors sample 4 identities per epoch from the wharf of pending payouts and test timing correlation above 0.8; a copper-matched cluster loses 60% of its bond.
